name: Fighter Battleforged Juggernaut
body:
Many battleforged were built as shock troops. These battleforged are covered in spikes and barrel through the lines of their enemies.

Requirement: A battleforged juggernaut must be a battleforged and have the armored body or juggernaut body alternative ancestral traits. A new ancestry from this book.

Powerful Charge

At 1st level, a battleforged juggernaut gains Powerful Charge as a bonus feat. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 1st level.

Armor Spikes (Ex)

At 2nd level, a battleforged juggernaut automatically grows armor spikes on their metal plates that deal 1d6 piercing damage as a separate weapon or on a successful grapple check. Their slam is also increased to 1d6 if it was not replaced and it deals bludgeoning and piercing damage. These spikes cannot be removed, but they can be enchanted like normal armor spikes. The spikes are treated as masterwork (without adding the bonus to attack) for the purpose of enchanting. At 8th level, the damage of the spikes and slam, if applicable, increase to 1d8. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 2nd level.

Battering Ram (Ex)

Starting at 2nd level, a battleforged juggernaut gains a +1 bonus to their bull rush attempts, their CMD against bull rush attempts, and their Strength checks to break down doors. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels beyond 2nd. This ability replaces bravery.

Destroyer (Ex)

Beginning with 4th level, a battleforged juggernaut can deal their armor spikes damage on a successful bull rush and when using the charge action if not already applied. They also gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls made on a charge and increase their speed by 5 feet when making a charge. The bonus increases by 1 and the speed increases by 5 feet at 9th, 13th, and 17th levels. This ability replaces weapon training.

Greater Powerful Charge

At 8th level, a battleforged juggernaut gains the Greater Powerful Charge feat as a bonus feat. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 8th level.
